title: The Bought Pardon
text: A pardoner works the crowd from a painted cart, selling forgiveness for every sin, signed and sealed with the Court's own bishop's mark. His prices go up with the sin. Business is good. Nobody here, it seems, is innocent.

options.label: Buy a pardon for the party. It cannot hurt to be forgiven.

outcomes.text: It does nothing at all, yet you sleep better. Perhaps that is what you paid for.

options.label: The shrewdest forges the bishop's seal, and goes into the forgiveness trade.

outcomes.text: You have pardons to sell back home, and no one will ever know.
The pardoner knows his own work. He also knows the guards, who come at his call.

options.label: Expose him to the crowd, and let them see what their forgiveness is worth.

outcomes.text: The crowd turns on him. Then, as crowds will, it turns on you.
